data.name: EXIT DATA
data.detailed_description:
Proceed to the exit. Should you feel any sense of unease, you may turn back.

About This Simulation
This simulation is an observational experiment designed to train an AI to follow the instruction: “Proceed to the exit, and turn back if you feel something is wrong.”

As the player, your actions will be directly observed and learned by the AI.
Various “exit”-themed objects are placed throughout the stage.
Please proceed forward unless you feel any discomfort — and turn back if you sense something unusual.

When the observation count reaches 9, the AI will have completed its learning process.

Note: Gameplay streaming and full playthrough videos are warmly welcomed.

How to Play 

This is a 3D spot-the-difference game.

If there are no differences, proceed toward the direction marked "EXIT."

If there is a difference, go in the opposite direction of the "EXIT" sign.

Correct actions increase the counter shown at the top-left of the screen, while mistakes reset it to 0.

Reach a counter of 9 to clear the game.

data.short_description: This simulation observes players heading toward exits and retreating when they sense something unusual. When the count reaches 9, the AI’s “learning” is complete. Note: The AI is a fictional element within the story, and no actual AI technology is used.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard output (onboard sound supported)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard output (onboard sound supported)
